newsitem.title: USA: Finish Line files for 3.0 mln shares.
newsitem.headline: Finish Line files for 3.0 mln shares.

text.p: Finish Line Inc filed Friday with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission for the public offering of up to 3.0 million common shares.
The Indianapolis-based athletic footwear retailer said it would sell 2.4 million shares, while certain stockholders may offer up to 600,000 shares.
It said it would use net proceeds to accelerate the expansion of its store base, fund potential acquistions and for general corporate purposes.
The offering will be made through Smith Barney & Co, A.G. Edwards & Sons Inc and Oppenheimer & Co Inc. The underwriters have an over-allotment option for up to 450,000 additional shares.
